entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to return something. It's my VeloBand Pulse monitor.

I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number? ... Thank you. I see the order here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 18 days ago. So I can best help, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
I think it's broken. The heart rate numbers are just all over the place. Sometimes it says 150 when I'm just sitting here. It feels like this thing is just... garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. That definitely sounds frustrating. A reading that high while resting could indicate a calibration issue. I can transfer you to our technical support team who can walk you through a firmware reset or diagnose the hardware fault.
Oh, no, that sounds really complicated. I just **don't have time** for all that. I honestly just want a **refund**. Can't you just help me with that?

I understand you'd prefer a simple return. Our policy for a potential defect outside the initial return window is to first verify the fault. We can't process a refund without that step. The technical team is the only department authorized to confirm a defect.
I don't want to talk to another person, I'm already talking to you. I **just want money** back for a product that doesn't work. I thought you had a 90-day return policy? I'm so confused by all this.

I can definitely clarify that, and I see why it's confusing. Our 90-day policy applies to our apparel and other gear. However, because the VeloBand Pulse is a newer electronic device that links directly to a user's health data account upon activation, it has its own specific policy. The return window for a refund is 10 days.
Ten days? I didn't see that anywhere. This is all too much. I'm just overwhelmed. Can't you just make an exception for me? I feel helpless here.

I truly wish I could, but since your order is from 18 days ago, the system won't allow me to process a refund for this item. Policy requires that a defect be verified by our technical team first. Without their verification, I have to adhere to the 10-day rule. The best and only path forward is to let me transfer you to them. They can approve a replacement if it's found to be faulty.
A replacement? Not a refund? And I have to call someone else... I don't know. It's just too much trouble. I guess I'm stuck with it.

I am sorry we couldn't resolve this the way you had hoped. The offer to connect you with technical support is always available if you change your mind. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
